name: Bollinger squeeze expansion breakout (15m)
rationale: A low Bollinger bandwidth on 15m is a volatility squeeze — a coiled, low-energy range. When price then pushes to the top of the range (high range_position) the squeeze is releasing UP, and compressed volatility tends to expand directionally. The other side is the range-fader who assumes the quiet range persists and is run over by the expansion. Edge persists because volatility clusters: compression is followed by expansion, and the breakout direction seeds a short trend. Distinct from plain channel breakouts by requiring prior compression. Disconfirmer: exits when price falls back inside the range (failed release) or the stop fires.
catalyst: volatility squeeze releasing to the upside
